Name: Maidenhair Fern
SpringCare: Begin monthly fertilizing; Mist often; Add tray with water for humidity
SummerCare: Mist regularly; Trim dead fronds; Never let soil dry
FallCare: Reduce watering slightly; Avoid direct light; Maintain humidity
WinterCare: Keep tray beneath pot filled; Keep away from windows and vents
Advice: Prefers pH 6.5 to 7 and high humidity. Use organic compost and keep soil consistently moist with a tray beneath the pot. This fern hates dry air and direct sunlight. Avoid touching the fronds. Bottom watering and misting work well.

Name: Asparagus Fern
SpringCare: Begin pruning lightly; Increase misting; Feed monthly
SummerCare: Maintain moist soil; Can be moved outside in shade
FallCare: Reduce feeding; Trim lightly; Keep out of wind
WinterCare: Keep soil moist; Bring indoors; Mist regularly
Advice: Prefers being rootbound. Use well-draining compost with pH around 6.5. High humidity improves leaf health. Avoid dry air. Prune when needed.

Name: Boston Fern
SpringCare: Reintroduce monthly fertilizer; Increase humidity
SummerCare: Mist daily; Avoid heat stress
FallCare: Slow down watering slightly; Trim dead fronds
WinterCare: Keep away from heaters; Mist daily; Maintain stable humidity
Advice: Needs high humidity and peat-based soil. Avoid letting the soil dry out. Yellow fronds can mean dryness or salt buildup. Flush occasionally with clean water.

Name: Calathea Amagris
SpringCare: Start monthly fertilizing; Use distilled water
SummerCare: Maintain high humidity; Avoid bright light
FallCare: Mist occasionally; Watch for dry tips
WinterCare: Keep warm; Reduce watering; Provide indirect light
Advice: Use a peat and coco coir mix with pH near 6.5. Water with dechlorinated or distilled water. Avoid soggy soil and harsh chemicals.

Name: Calathea Exotica
Traits: tall leaves, sensitive to water quality
SpringCare: Start gentle feeding; Keep moist; Mist daily
SummerCare: Avoid cold water; Keep away from direct sun
FallCare: Reduce watering slightly; Wipe leaves
WinterCare: Keep warm; Maintain humidity
Advice: Similar to Amagris. Needs soft, well-draining soil. Avoid dry air and unfiltered tap water. Curling leaves mean it's too dry or water quality is poor.

Name: Snake Plant
SpringCare: Resume light watering; Rotate pot
SummerCare: Water deeply and let dry; Avoid direct heat
FallCare: Water less often; Wipe dust from leaves
WinterCare: Water sparingly; Keep above 50F
Advice: Tolerates low light and neglect. Use coco coir-based soil. Root rot is common if overwatered. Let soil fully dry before watering again.

Name: Pothos
SpringCare: Start monthly feeding; Wipe leaves; Check for root crowding
SummerCare: Water more in heat; Avoid direct sunlight; Trim vines
FallCare: Reduce watering slightly; Watch for yellowing leaves
WinterCare: Keep moist but not wet; Avoid cold drafts
Advice: Tolerant of many conditions. Grows quickly and can be propagated in water. Yellowing leaves often mean overwatering.

Name: ZZ Plant
SpringCare: Start monthly feeding; Clean leaves; Rotate pot
SummerCare: Let soil dry between waterings; Tolerates dry air
FallCare: Reduce watering slightly
WinterCare: Water once a month; Keep in a warm spot
Advice: Very low maintenance. Shiny leaves and thick rhizomes store water. Avoid overwatering. Perfect for offices or low-light spaces.

Name: Peace Lily
SpringCare: Use balanced fertilizer; Keep soil moist
SummerCare: Mist regularly; Avoid direct sunlight
FallCare: Reduce watering; Expect fewer blooms
WinterCare: Keep warm and lightly watered
Advice: Soil should stay moist but not soggy. Dramatic wilting signals thirst. Toxic to pets. Clean leaves and use filtered water if tips brown.

Name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
SpringCare: Feed every 2 weeks; Rotate for even sun
SummerCare: Mist daily; Can move outdoors if warm
FallCare: Reduce feeding; Watch for pests or leaf drop
WinterCare: Keep warm and bright; Reduce watering
Advice: Use peat and perlite mix with good drainage. Avoid moving often. Clean leaves. Sensitive to cold and inconsistent watering.

Name: Chinese Evergreen
SpringCare: Start monthly feeding; Rotate regularly
SummerCare: Mist lightly; Avoid harsh sun
FallCare: Ease off watering; Wipe leaves
WinterCare: Water less often; Avoid drafts
Advice: Can survive neglect. Best in filtered light. Use soil with perlite and bark. Toxic to pets. Wipe leaves to maintain shine.

Name: Spider Plant
SpringCare: Feed monthly; Remove offshoots
SummerCare: Water a bit more in heat; Mist occasionally
FallCare: Cut brown tips; Reduce watering
WinterCare: Move to brighter spot; Water less often
Advice: Prefers to be rootbound. Avoid fluoride in tap water. Great for hanging pots. Brown tips are common but not dangerous.

Name: Parlor Palm
WaterNeeds: Water when top inch is dry
SpringCare: Light monthly feeding; Trim dead fronds
SummerCare: Increase light slightly; Mist weekly
FallCare: Reduce feeding; Maintain light
WinterCare: Keep warm; Avoid overwatering
Advice: Classic indoor palm. Likes consistent conditions. Yellow leaves often mean too much water or low light. Avoid cold spots.

Name: Orchid
SpringCare: Use bloom fertilizer; Avoid crown watering
SummerCare: Watch humidity; Use airy bark mix
FallCare: Cut old flower spikes; Feed lightly
WinterCare: Keep in bright room; Water once per week
Advice: Needs orchid-specific potting mix. Water at base, not the crown. Keep roots airy. Mist only in dry air. Avoid soggy roots.

Name: Donkey Ears
SpringCare: Water lightly; Check for new pups
SummerCare: Can tolerate full sun; Water deeply
FallCare: Cut back leggy growth; Use dry soil
WinterCare: Keep dry and warm
Advice: Kalanchoe with thick leaves and pups on edges. Needs sandy soil and strong drainage. Do not overwater. Remove pups to repot.

Name: Nerve Plant
SpringCare: Feed monthly; Mist daily
SummerCare: Keep cool and moist; Avoid sun
FallCare: Ease up watering; Watch leaf edges
WinterCare: Use humidifier or tray
Advice: Also called Fittonia. Perfect for terrariums. Droops dramatically when thirsty. Use peat-based soil. High humidity is essential.

Name: Philodendron Heartleaf
SpringCare: Start feeding monthly; Add stake or trellis
SummerCare: Trim vines; Avoid direct sun
FallCare: Rotate plant; Reduce watering
WinterCare: Water only when soil feels dry
Advice: Great for hanging or shelf pots. Easy to propagate. Slightly toxic. Use airy soil with perlite. Wipe leaves monthly.

Name: Club Moss (Frosty)
SpringCare: Use pebble tray; Mist regularly
SummerCare: Avoid direct heat; Keep moist
FallCare: Trim lightly; Reduce watering
WinterCare: Keep tray full; Provide stable humidity
Advice: Prefers peat and coir in shallow containers. Very sensitive to drying out. Ideal for bathrooms. Keep away from direct heat.

Name: Peace Lily
SpringCare: Start fertilizer routine; Clean leaves
SummerCare: Mist often; Avoid bright light
FallCare: Fewer blooms expected; Reduce watering
WinterCare: Keep warm and humid
Advice: Easy to read: wilts when thirsty, perks up after. Great for low light. Soil should stay evenly moist. Toxic if ingested.

Name: Rex Begonia
SpringCare: Feed biweekly; Use shallow pot
SummerCare: Avoid direct sun; Mist carefully
FallCare: Ease up feeding; Trim leggy growth
WinterCare: Keep warm; Use humidifier
Advice: Gorgeous foliage plant. Needs porous mix in shallow container. Keep leaves dry. Avoid moving often. Bright but indirect light preferred.
